messages:
jen: getting a few live reports of frozen video + delayed captions. audio is stable from the stage. @video-team please advise. :rotating_light:
mark: seeing encoder enc-04 drop frames and CPU spike, looking at tail logs now.
mark: ```enc-04 WARN backlog_ms=600
enc-04 ERROR reconnect to ingest failed```
priya: let's continue audio-only Q&A and put a notice slide. start a local capture too in case we need to stitch.
gabe: prepping backup ingest and asking stage ops for SD handoff. flipping DNS in 20s if needed.
ops-bot: Incident created IN-2026-451: live all-hands video degraded -> paging video-team.
emma: starting local OBS capture: profile=allhands_fallback -> /tmp/allhands_1965432100.mp4 (cmd: `obs-cli --startrecording`).
zach: NDI shows last-keyframe age spiking to 2.8s; likely network burst between switcher and encoder.
leo: putting up slide: "Video degraded — continuing audio Q&A" and posting to participants.
mark: doing DNS flip to backup ingest in 3...2...1... swapped. monitoring.
mark: backup ingest accepted stream, bitrate recovering. can folks confirm video returned? :eyes:
emma: player shows picture returning, local file growing. I'll upload raw when stable.
priya: hosted archive missing ~40s around the glitch. Gabe, can you copy cam1 SD so we can stitch?
gabe: grabbing cam1 SD, copying to s3://allhands-raw/1965432100/cam1/ (upload started).
leo: will stitch emma's local + cam1 when upload completes. ETA 15m for a short clip.
ops-bot: Action logged: TICKET-ALLHANDS-217 "Enable automatic local-record fallback for all-hands" assigned to ops.
mark: added encoder firmware patch to follow-ups; uploading logs to s3://infra-logs/allhands/1965432100/encoder.log (video-team perms).
jen: thanks team — good failover. please add heartbeat overlay and a preflight check to the postmortem list. closing after clip posted. :white_check_mark:
